dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Ways to Make Friends With Saurians...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh, there are so many cute Saurians in Natlan! Paimon's gonna make friends with every single one!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You bet! Paimon's got it all figured out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh you do, huh? Come on then, what's the secret to making Saurian friends?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's really simple! First, you've gotta sweet-talk them, show 'em you mean well so they relax their defenses. Then, you gently pat them on the head — that makes them feel more comfortable around you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Last but not least: Get 'em some good grub! The way to a Saurian's heart is through the stomach, after all! What do you think? Solid plan, huh?

choices.text: Hmm, why do I get the feeling that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Would not! Paimon can't be won over by some cheap tricks!

choices.text: Huh? Oh, you misunderstand! I meant to say that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah! Flattery, really? You think that'll work on Paimon? Think again!

choices.text: But I was being sincere, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, really? Sweet Madame? Oh, heck yes! Paimon could totally go for some of that right now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Uhh... What's with that smug look on your face? ...What!? Is Paimon missing something?

choices.text: Ah, how can I prove it you? With some Sweet Madame, perhaps?
You're as cute as a baby Saurian!
These tactics would also work really well on you?
